# Items of the V2 kit named as a CLASS with no manufacturer part number chosen, one per line with what
# the pick needs. No datasheet can exist for these until a part is ruled, so they are not missing
# documents: they are outstanding design decisions, and an inventory that listed only the decided
# parts would hide them.
#
# Owner ruling 11 September 2026: each of these is researched against manufacturer documents and comes
# back as a recommendation with evidence, one at a time. A line disappears from here when its part is
# ruled, and reappears in the inventory as a part number with its datasheet.

toggle-safety-covers   # RECOMMENDED: the APEM CSG series switch guard, which APEM's own page states is for the 5000M and 600H toggles, and our SOS, EMCON and ZEROIZE switches are APEM 5636ADKB-2V of that 5000 series. It carries an anti-tamper wire seal hole as standard, which suits ZEROIZE. The series document is filed in switches/ and is image-only: its OCR recovers the title and nothing else, so THE ORDER CODE IS STILL OWED and has to come from APEM's product page or a distributor
headset-jack-U174U     # two U-174/U panel jacks, Amphenol Nexus class, drawing owed; PANEL section 19 and ASSEMBLY line 25 depend on the panel hole and the sealing method
camera-module          # a USB camera module about 25 x 25 mm behind an 8 mm sealed window with a 1.0 mm PC disc on VHB 5915
sealed-rj45-wall       # RECOMMENDED: Bulgin PX0833, Standard Buccaneer front-panel CAT5e shielded coupler, IP68 with its own panel gasket, single-hole mount, datasheet filed in bulgin/. It is a sealed coupler with a patch lead doing the cable run, which is exactly this design's shape, and the V1 kits already use the Bulgin 400 Series inlet so the family is known here. The Amphenol RJField is the alternative and is built for field assembly we do not need
sealed-usbc-wall       # RECOMMENDED: Bulgin PXP4043/C, IP-sealed C-type USB rear panel mount with a 2 x 12 way header at the rear, IP66/IP68/IP69K, USB 3.2 up to Gen 2x2, datasheet filed in bulgin/. OWED: confirm its contact current rating carries 45 W PD (20 V at 2.25 A) before it is ordered
m8-pod-receptacle      # RECOMMENDED: binder 86 6618 1121 00004, M8 female panel mount, 4 contacts, shieldable, THT, IP67, M10 x 0.75 rear fastened, 60 V and 4 A, -40 to +85 C. Four contacts is exactly the pod's need: 3V3, GND, SDA, SCL
ground-stud            # the ground stud on the wall plate
ip68-fans              # RECOMMENDED for the two 60 mm mixer fans: Same Sky CFM-6025BG68, 60 x 60 x 25 mm, 12 V, IP68, ball bearing, in the -22 variant which carries both tachometer and PWM. FINDING THAT NEEDS A RULING: no reputable maker offers an IP68 fan BELOW 60 mm. Same Sky starts at 60, Orion at 60, ebm-papst at 92. Delta lists 40 mm in its IP68 line but publishes the part numbers only through a filter its site serves by script. So the three 40 mm cooler fans are either 60 mm, or a Delta 40 mm part obtained through a distributor, or not IP68
vhf-2m-antenna         # the 2 m whip for the VHF jack; no maker's brochure on file covers it
xenarc-rear-frame      # the steel rear frame under the plate holding the 709GNK, four M4 x 8; a new part whose drawing is owed
gdt-arrestors          # RECOMMENDED: PolyPhaser GTH-SFF-AL, SMA female to female bulkhead RF surge protector, DC to 6 GHz, 150 W, 10 kA, gas discharge tube, datasheet filed in polyphaser/. It passes DC, which the active GNSS antenna needs, and 150 W covers the 30 W VHF path with margin. One per antenna bulkhead that leaves the case
tamper-switch          # one sealed case-open switch under the frame, feeding the ZEROIZE logic
geiger-tube-board      # the Geiger board and tube; RadiationD-v1.1 class with an SBM-20 tube is recorded as the class, with J305 as an alternative
5g-jack-count          # RECOMMENDED: FOUR jacks. Settled from Quectel's own RM520N Series Hardware Design v1.1, page 19 and Table 32 on page 59: the GL variant carries ANT0, ANT1, ANT2 and ANT3, and all four are live paths (ANT0 TX0/PRX low, mid and ultra-high band; ANT1 PRX MIMO; the EU variant adds ANT4 for GNSS, which the GL does not have). Two jacks would give up MIMO on the main bands. COSTS A CASE CHANGE: the east wall carries eleven bulkheads today and this makes thirteen
rugged-tablet          # the 8 to 10 inch rugged tablet in the lid and its bracket, which is not drawn; BUILD.md lists it among the part picks owed, and it stays here even though the kit costing treats it as an accessory
